question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Anita looked ______ the word in the dictionary, but she still did not understand it.
solution:
The correct answer is: **up**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Look up**" is a phrasal verb
